description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of an electric toothbrush, specifically an Oral-B Braun model, positioned upright in its charging base. The toothbrush has a white handle with a blue accent near the top and features a digital display screen on the front, which is currently off or displaying no information. The brand name "Oral-B" and "BRAUN" are clearly visible on the handle. The charging base is metallic silver with a blue circular ring where the toothbrush rests
